payload.summary: Toast host is never mounted, so 35 files hand-roll their own 'Copied' confirmation
payload.detail: grep -rn 'ui/toast' src returns nothing; on-call-copy-number.tsx:36-37 states it in a comment. 35 in-scope files implement their own copy confirmation against 2 using ui/copy-button.tsx, with four different wordings. The 2026-07-07 fix for single-slot notifications overwriting each other exists as a primitive but nothing mounts it. Copying a dose or citation is high-frequency here and the confirmation differs by mode.
